_note: Transposed from GoogleInteractionsAdapter.streamEvents. The discriminator is `event_type ?? type`, which is what the match LIST expresses. interaction.created / status_update / requires_action map to no unified event and are simply absent from the cases.

callId._note: The open function call: its argument fragments and its close carry only an index.

sawToolCall._note: Decides the finish reason on the terminal frame.

step.delta._note: thought_signature and other delta kinds are internal, so they map to nothing.
